'''Business and economy'''
* The [[Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore]] founds a company, SAFCo, to meet [[Singapore]]'s goal of utilizing [[Aviation biofuel|sustainable aviation fuel]] in flights. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/sustainable-aviation-fuel-safco-caas-levy-passengers-5434531 (CNA)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 21 people are killed and at least 18 bodies are recovered in [[landslide]]s in [[Enga Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/papua-new-guinea-landslide-14e9cf05b4a7c5228eaccec1b33b6579 (AP)]

'''International relations '''
*The [[United Nations Security Council]] approves a [[United States]]-backed [[United Nations resolution|resolution]] supporting [[Morocco]]'s [[Western Sahara Autonomy Proposal|autonomy proposal]] and claim to the disputed [[Western Sahara]], despite opposition from [[Algeria]]. [https://apnews.com/article/un-western-sahara-morocco-peacekeeping-force-0a07d389db0e88c35beeb5f0462ea221 (AP)]

'''Law and crime''' 
*[[2025 Kartalkaya hotel fire]]
**A [[Judicial system of Turkey|court]] in [[Turkey]] sentences the owner of [[Kartalkaya]] hotel to [[life in prison]] after finding him guilty of severe [[negligence]] in the fire at his hotel in January, which killed 78 people, including 34 children. [https://apnews.com/article/turkey-deadly-ski-resort-fire-trial-sentences-6a4dda7ad84983541a57ff4b1e0e72f4 (AP)]
*[[2025 Tanzanian election protests]]
**The [[United Nations]] says ten deaths have occurred due to protests in [[Tanzania]] following the [[2025 Tanzanian general election|general election]]. [https://apnews.com/article/tanzania-election-samia-suluhu-protests-dar-es-salaam-01f98d2009f59c577080647bdbb58106 (AP)]
*[[Capital punishment in India]]
**A court in [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]], sentences five people to death for the November 2015 assassination of the mayor of [[Chittoor]] and her husband. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/vijayawada/chittoor-mayor-husband-murder-case-andhra-court-hands-out-death-penalty-for-5-people/articleshow/124987208.cms (''The Times of India'')]
*Police in [[Guyana]] arrest opposition leader [[Azruddin Mohamed]] following an [[indictment]] by a [[federal grand jury]] in [[Florida]], United States, and an [[extradition]] request by American authorities, who accuse him of several [[financial crime]]s. [https://apnews.com/article/guyana-azruddin-mohamed-arrested-us-extradition-8b209b01a817189b4e700a93e6dac5a5 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Moldovan parliamentary election]]
**[[Moldova]]'s [[Parliament of Moldova|parliament]] appoints [[Alexandru Munteanu (economist)|Alexandru Munteanu]] as [[Prime Minister of Moldova|prime minister]] following the victory of [[President of Moldova|President]] [[Maia Sandu]]'s [[Party of Action and Solidarity]] in the September election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/moldova-appoints-pro-eu-munteanu-prime-minister-2025-10-31/ (Reuters)]
